name: Eimear
source: A rogue operating outside the confines of the law, Eimear looks to do what is right in her own ways. With a pair of sharp daggers, she doesn't hesitate to brandish her weapon when talks fail. Despite being terse at times, she can sometimes be spotted at the orphanage according to the banters of some children.
